claims.claimText: RWTH's exam-related questions document treats unauthorized use of AI systems in exams as an attempt to deceive, but says suspicion should not primarily be based on automatic AI-detector evaluation.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Generell stellt der unzulässige Einsatz von KI-Systemen einen Täuschungsversuch dar. Konnte ein solcher Täuschungsversuch nicht direkt beobachtet werden, liegt ein Täuschungsverdacht vor. Nach aktuellem Stand kann ein solcher Täuschungsverdacht dabei nicht primär auf die Bewertung durch ein automatisches System zur KI-Detektion gestützt werden.

security_procurement.meaningZh: 校级部署服务（第三方采购规范未核实）

do.en: Use official RWTHgpt with your university Single Sign-On credentials for study assistance.
do.zh: 使用校园统一身份认证（SSO）登录官方RWTHgpt辅助学习。

do.en: Check the specific AI rules for your examination and meet the requirement for independent work.
do.zh: 核对具体考试的AI使用规则，并满足独立完成的要求。

dont.en: Do not assume that access to an AI tool settles whether its use meets your examination’s independence requirement.
dont.zh: 不要以拥有AI工具访问权来推断其使用符合考试独立性要求。

dont.en: Meet the independence requirement applicable to your examination work.
dont.zh: 遵守考试成果适用的独立完成要求。

coursework:rwth-coursework-services-grou.text: RWTHgpt is made available to students via KI:connect, while permission to use AI in coursework assessments remains subject to instructor discretion.
coursework:rwth-coursework-services-grou.summaryZh: 全校学生免额外角色直接免费使用RWTHgpt

evidence.quote: Since December 11, 2024, students are also able to use RWTHgpt. No separate role or activation is necessary for this.

exams:rwth-exam-framework-group.text: RWTH’s general examination regulations require independent work across forms of examination.

privacy_data:rwth-privacy-external-group.text: Students may not be required to use registration-based services not provided by the university for a course or examination; RWTH recommends using services it provides.
privacy_data:rwth-privacy-external-group.summaryZh: 禁止强制学生注册外部商业账号且仅推荐校级服务
